assistedInstructions: Present your Holy Symbol or weapon. Each chosen creature makes the displayed Wisdom saving throw on its own sheet.
On a failed save, set Frightened on that target's sheet for 1 minute or until it takes any damage; this effect does not require Concentration.

While Frightened by Abjure Foes, the target can do only one of these on its turn: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action. Resolve this additional restriction and the effect's expiration manually.

notes: Targets, attack triggers, and applied conditions remain assisted.

nodes.text: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of this class’s Channel Divinity to overwhelm foes with awe. As you present your Holy Symbol or weapon, you can target a number of creatures equal to your

Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature) that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage. While Frightened in this way, a target can do only one of the following on its turns: move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action.
